basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 21-year-old from Georgetown, TX, currently navigating the bustling vibes of Austin. I'm fascinated by the mysterious world of cryptids and love spending my weekends exploring the outdoors, hoping for a sighting of Bigfoot or any other elusive creature. When I'm not on Reddit, I'm usually working part-time at a local cafe. I'm single and spend my free time diving into cryptid lore, jamming to music, or tweaking my car's audio system. You can usually find me online during the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a growing interest in cryptids, mostly fueled by online research and local stories. My knowledge about audio equipment and population dynamics comes from hands-on experience and reading through forums like Focusrite and overpopulation. I'm also learning about cars and Bluetooth technology, often turning to YouTube and Reddit for guidance.
